2027 contracts and price per IT MW
model: Economic engine: IREN owns powered sites and the GPUs on them, selling AI cloud on 3-year to 5-year contracts with large prepayments. Revenue map: active IT MW x price per MW-year (recent contracts above $20mn per IT MW). Costs: power, GPU depreciation (about six years, press), staff, interest. Funding: GPU financing ($3.6bn at about 6% for Microsoft, $2.4bn at 9.0% for Mackenzie), prepayments 45% to 55% of GPU capex, converts, equity. Sensitivities: commissioning dates, GPU prices, tenant credit, financing costs. Would break the model: ARR slips, unfunded capex, Microsoft loss, GPU price fall. Sources: FY26 release and call.
